faithfulness.annotator: Claude (Sonnet 5.5), reading each generated text against its cited passages; strict rubric: supported = every statement is in the facts, the rule note or the cited passage; partly = a statement is softened, loosely supported, misleading in emphasis or cites a passage for no claim; unsupported = a statement is in none of them.
